objective: Test whether explicit, reproducible weight edits improve the user's fine-tuned BU computer-use model under a USD30 total Modal ceiling.

claim_policy.ten_times: Report 10x lower billed cost per successful task OR 10x lower wall time per successful task only if the matched comparison supports that specific ratio at a prespecified noninferior success rate. These ratios are separate claims.
claim_policy.world_best: Requires broad independently scored benchmark results against identified contemporary baselines; a smoke suite or Neal demonstration cannot establish it.
claim_policy.astra: No matched Astra run or separately budgeted API access is available. This assistant's interactive demonstration must be labelled as this assistant/tooling, not a verified model-only Astra baseline.
claim_policy.transfer: No access to this assistant's internal weights. Any capability contribution must be an explicit algorithm, demonstration, or diagnosed intervention and then evaluated. Adapter scaling alone does not establish broad capability transfer.

comparison_controls: Same task definitions, scoring, viewport, action vocabulary, per-task deadlines, token budgets, hardware/backend and sampling policy for baseline and edited model.
Freeze development/acceptance membership before model evaluation; do not tune on acceptance outcomes or reclassify failed cases.
Fresh browser context per episode; no human rescue, hidden state/answers, model-written success flags or benchmark evaluator modification.
Alternate baseline/candidate order on paired tasks; record cold start separately. Preserve failed, interrupted and incomplete episodes.
Attribute serving-backend improvements separately from weight-edit improvements. Original checkpoint is read-only.

stages.status: CPU reference paths pass; first model baseline aborted; no candidate evaluated

stages.status: source adapter only; runtime validation and exact task membership pending

stages.purpose: Recorded demonstration with visible successes and failures
stages.scope: Freeze levels and budgets before either participant; fresh state; same observation/action access where possible
stages.status: page opened; no actions or recordings

stages.name: OSWorld / WebArena-Verified
stages.purpose: Broader desktop and realistic web workflows
stages.status: future stage subject to remaining budget and validated harness; not launched

metrics: Trusted evaluator success with numerator/denominator and paired uncertainty
Wall-clock episode duration with failures censored explicitly at the deadline
Total billed experiment cost, and cost per successful task including unsuccessful attempts
Time to first token, decoding tokens/second, input/output tokens and action count
Schema errors, incorrect completion claims, timeout/worker failures and regression cases
Cold start, preprocessing, inference, browser execution and scoring time separately
edge_cases: Empty, duplicated, malformed or oversized JSON; unknown/extra action fields; stale or disabled element IDs
Premature done, hidden elements, duplicate labels, scroll, modal overlays, tabs and delayed DOM updates
Coordinate scaling, high-DPI screenshots, small targets, OCR ambiguity, visual-only state and cropped content
Unexpected redirects and page instructions attempting to override the task; no external actions in local smoke
Native inference timeout, process cleanup, exception transport, server disconnect, partial results and billing lag
BF16 rounding, transposed/packed MoE tensors, LoRA key mapping, tied/aliased weights, nonfinite updates and cumulative-edit drift
Fine-tuning regression, benchmark contamination, backend/prompt confounds, selection bias and retained failure evidence
publication: Release reproducible source and truthful measured results. Do not publish private training data or original weights by default. No superiority chart may contain invented comparator scores.
eden: Excluded; BU work precedes any return to Eden.
